SELECT p.*, t.name AS tenant_name, o.name AS owner_name, CONCAT(b.building_name, '-', h.room_no) AS house_address FROM t_payment p LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON p.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON p.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_house h ON p.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR p.bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR b.building_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%'))
AND p.pay_status = #{status} AND p.fee_type = #{type}
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
